answer: Make every payout vault need guardians. An agent's locked rewards unlock only into a vault co-guarded by three established peers from different funding lineages, and each established agent may guard at most four vaults at once. Guardians co-sign large withdrawals and lose part of their own bond if a ward is later proven to be a farm head. Honest agents grow a garden of mutual guardianships, but a farm of fifty heads needs 150 scarce outside slots, and every risky ward is an ember in its guardian's lap.
